95:1.text: By the fig and the olive

95:4.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

95:5.text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

95:6.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

95:7.text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

95:8.text: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

96:1.text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created

96:2.text: Created man from a clinging substance.

96:3.text: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

96:5.text: Taught man that which he knew not.

96:8.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

96:9.text: Have you seen the one who forbids

96:11.text: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

96:13.text: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

96:14.text: Does he not know that Allāh sees?

96:15.text: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock

96:17.text: Then let him call his associates;

96:18.text: We will call the angels of Hell.

96:19.text: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near
